worldcombat.skill.smog.summary: The user inhales and breathes a single cloud of filthy smog that rolls slowly forward and swells as it goes; it travels from the mouth to the far end of its range, its cross-section widening to the full cone width, and everyone it coats takes a little damage and is very likely poisoned. Short range and low damage, but the highest poison chance, and real walls stop the cloud. Billow style is wider, farther and more poisonous at the cost of a slower roll and a lighter pass.
worldcombat.skill.smog.use.0: Poison whoever stands in a narrow way ahead
worldcombat.skill.smog.use.1: Pre-roll a corridor mouth to force a detour
worldcombat.skill.smog.use.2: Spam poison with its deep PP
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.0: The mouth opens %3$s blocks wide and the cloud swells to a %2$s degree cone width by the end of its roll; each foe it coats takes about %1$s damage.
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.1: The cloud rolls up to %1$s blocks; those it coats have a %2$s poison chance, and a real wall stops it short.
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.2: It takes about %1$s s to roll from the mouth to the end, then thins out and clears; the caster may act right after breathing.
worldcombat.skill.smog.billow.on: Billow style on: ×1.2 cone angle, ×1.15 range and ×1.15 poison chance, at ×0.85 damage per pass and a slower roll.
worldcombat.skill.smog.billow.off: Billow style off (Sharp breath): a tighter, denser cloud with ×1.15 damage that comes out faster.
worldcombat.skill.smog.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.smog.growth.0: At level %1$s the smog rises to %2$s power and %3$s degrees wide.
worldcombat.skill.smog.growth.1: At level %1$s the smog rises to %2$s power and the poison chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.billow: On: ×1.2 cone angle, ×1.15 range and ×1.15 poison chance, at ×0.85 damage per pass and a slower roll, for covering a group. Off (Sharp breath): a tighter, denser cloud with ×1.15 damage that comes out faster, for poisoning one target precisely.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.ai.max: Only foes within this distance become breath candidates; the shared approach logic then walks the companion into breath range. Higher starts the chase earlier.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.ai.see: On, the decision values how many foes along the fog path are not yet poisoned; a poisoned main target is still worth breathing at while unpoisoned foes remain on the path. Off counts poisoned foes too.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.ai.clu: On, the more foes the fog path covers the higher it ranks, coating the group in one breath; off keeps the normal attack order.
worldcombat.skill.smog.preference.ai.lea: On, the companion may leave its post to breathe at a target; off restricts it to breaths it can make from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.poiso: The poison lasts %1$s, draining health over time without defeating the target, and can be cured; Poison-type, Steel-type and suitably immune targets are not poisoned.
worldcombat.skill.smog.description.targe: One rolling cloud coats at most %1$s enemies, and each is settled only once.
